TITLE: [FI] Siscaly Tournament
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] A tournament gathering for every Siscaly player confident in their skills to decide who is the strongest "Sister-user." To Kirino, who really loves sister-related games, this tournament greatly attracted her interest. On a side note, Siscaly's official title is "Shin Imouto Taisen Siscalypse," a 3D Bishoujo fighting game. And so, I

probably can't refuse to participate...

TITLE: [FI] AniMate
DESCRIPTION: [FI] A store specialized in selling anime-related goods. The store houses special events, offers purchase bonuses, and is vigorously expanding nationwide.

TITLE: [FI] Yes
DESCRIPTION: [FI] A choice given in the world of "Destiny Record". By answering the question of the fairies that govern fate, a new future will reveal itself. So it seems, but I'm not convinced. Anyway, choose this if you agree to the question asked.

TITLE: [FI] No
DESCRIPTION: [FI] A choice given in the world of "Destiny Record", part 2. Minor details aside, being a yes-man is just boring. It is also important to say no every once in a while. In that situation, choose this [O.R.E.].

TITLE: [FI] Middle Schooler
DESCRIPTION: [FI] You never know what pitfalls lie ahead, even if you plan on walking the path of a wholesome life... For example, my current situation. Well, what I'm saying is, I didn't fall in love with her because she's a middle schooler, she just happened to be a middle schooler. That part is extremely important, okay? Don't get the wrong idea!

TITLE: [FI] High Schooler
DESCRIPTION: [FI] You know... The way you're asking this is just riddled with bad intentions. These choices make me look shady, no matter how healthy a relationship I'm in. Maybe I'm just being paranoid?

TITLE: [FI] Invite Kirino
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] The result of my fated choice. At the same time, it's the first step towards a tumultuous summer. What lies ahead, probably me being pulled around by Kirino more than ever. Well, I don't have any other plans anyway, so I'll hang with her.

Since we started dating, I have been scrambling around, trying to get everyone's approval. After all this time, I found out just how protected I've been by the people around me. Now, I have to step up and protect Kirino. At least I can no longer say something like "My sister can't be this cute!"

TITLE: [FI] Invite Kuroneko
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] This summer, I invited my girlfriend, Kuroneko. Come to think of it, we haven't done anything like what a couple would ever since we started dating. This is a good opportunity so maybe I should ask her out on a date. I'm sure it'll be a good summer memory. No, I don't have any ulterior motives at all, okay?

After dating Kuroneko for some time, I understand everything. What do I mean? She's really awkward, and yet she always works hard. Don't say I found out too late. I'll work hard to make her not run amok and I shall become a man that can put her at ease.

TITLE: [FI] Invite Saori
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] Invite the girl I just started dating this summer, Saori, out. After being confessed to and becoming lovers, we haven't seen each other since. It's a good opportunity, won't hurt to ask her out and to make some summer memories with her. I wonder whether she'll come as her "usual" or "lady" self... I'm looking forward to it.

Saori is stuck with an inferiority complex since her childhood with her sister. Said sister doesn't seem to know how to treat her little sister too. The life counseling of these sisters might be tough. Conquering Saori's shyness will take some time but... well, best to take it slow. After all, I've got a good ally.

TITLE: [FI] Invite Manami
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] Invite my childhood friend whom I recently started dating, Manami. We are both going to be taking university entrance exams so... well, I think I can pass, Manami will be just fine. We only get to experience this final summer of our high school once, nothing wrong with creating some summer memories. But it's kinda embarrassing to ask her out again...

Sometime during our university student years, Manami's grandfather arranged for us a trip to Kyoto out of his kindness. I blindly accepted it since I was uneasy that our relationship's been slow for such a long time. Can't believe everything was in the palm of his hand. Well, thanks to him, we've reaffirmed each others' feelings; I really appreciate it.

TITLE: [FI] Invite Ayase
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] Invite my lover, and my lovely angel, Ayase-tan... Hey, don't call me creepy. Starting in Fall, we'll have less time to see each other in the midst of exam season, so we should make a bunch of memories this Summer. I got a text saying her work is wrapping up soon, I'll go pick her up and ask her out somewhere.

I had a flirty date with my girlfriend, Ayase. There isn't much to say, really. I don't recall anything like the impact of a high kick to my head, being stabbed by something silver, or a freezing crimson end. That didn't happen at all.

TITLE: [FI] Invite Kanako
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] Invite Kanako, who became my girlfriend this summer. Before I knew it, I'm already in my final year of high school. This summer is going to be the last time I can just have fun without any worries. So flirting around with a cheeky, foul-mouthed, but hardworking girlfriend isn't a bad idea... I'll take her to the beach, it is summer after all.

This is a story of how I became a lolicon from Kanako's cuteness. It's scary just how unexpectedly accurate that is. There were ups and downs and Kanako did a lot for me but... let's not talk about that here. Lolicon banzai!!

TITLE: [FI] SisSis
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] SisSis is the nickname for the PC game, "SisXSis～A Siscon Love Story." It is an illustrated multiple playthroughs-required tragic love triangle relationship game with the protagonist's little sisters, Rinko and Miyabi. To Kirino, it is on the level of a godly game that needs deep contemplation. The other day, the game that Kirino

bought was "SisSis Moushouden." The one that I made Ayase play was the one with the new heroine "Asahi" added, "SisXSis All Ages Edition."

TITLE: [FI] Go to the Games Research Club
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] I went through so much trouble to join the club, so I should show up this summer. After all, it's pretty cozy there. Sure, I might be studying for my entrance exams, but if I go overboard and fall sick, that'll be the end of me. It's a bit of a breather. Well, I'm sure this is rude to those who treat game creation so seriously...

It's the story of me going after the much-anticipated new heroine Akagi Sena and falling in love. We get together, make games, go on dates... and I realize that even though she's a fujoshi, she's actually just a normal girl. Wow, my values sure have changed a lot. That said, I want no part of her homoerotic delusions, okay?

TITLE: [FI] Pervert
DESCRIPTION: [FI] In a sudden burst of anger, this is what Kirino said as she hit me. Seriously, all I did was point out a fact. She didn't have to get that mad. Owww it hurts...

TITLE: [FI] Lover-ish?
DESCRIPTION: [FI] The seriously cool Kanako said this to us. I used all those words explaining to her and yet... maybe she's just an idiot? Where did she get that idea from looking at us...

TITLE: [FI] Become My Boyfriend
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] My precious little sister gave me the last life consultation. This wouldn't be possible between us back then. My "little sister" has become my "girlfriend" so... well, um, uhh. Honestly though, being with her ain't so bad...

I confessed to my parents that I had started dating Kirino. To be honest, I was crazy nervous. I just wanted to run away. Still, I can't show my "girlfriend" how uncool I am... But my Dad... "I don't have to feel uneasy about giving Kirino away in marriage", was that the right thing to say?

We all have to be independent at some point. Even if it means leaving our warm and cozy home... Thank you, Manami. I'll give it my all to make Kirino happy. I hope that someday, the three of us can laugh together again.

TITLE: [FI] Kuroneko's Swimsuit
DESCRIPTION: [FI] The swimsuit Kuroneko wore when we went to collect shells. Extremely adorable. It created a nice mood between us. But, with Hinata and Tamaki showing up, that mood ended in an instant.

TITLE: [FI] Like Lovers
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] Ever since I've been dating Kuroneko, I've been thinking a lot. How does one act like a lover? I know stuff like holding hands and going on dates but... what would it take to be seen as lovers in everyday life...? Well, it's fine, since we had fun together today.

Apparently I wasn't the only one struggling with the idea of lovers. She's being way too negative. There's no way I could ever hate her... Also, oh yes. Kuroneko's reaction was really cute so, next time let's try catching her off-guard by calling her by her real name...

I couldn't see anything. Judging from Kuroneko's reaction, it seemed like the right answer but, it feels like I've come up short... Crap, what the heck's going on...!?

TITLE: [FI] Kuroneko's Mannerisms
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Lately I have gotten used to Kuroneko's words and actions and I've come to understand what she really means. I'm confident at just how much I know her. But well... When she gets restless and really fidgety, I fail to decipher what she means. And those are the only times she won't explain when I ask her.

TITLE: [FI] Matsudo Black Cat
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Seems like there's a highly skilled gamer known as the Matsudo Black Cat who shows up at arcades around here. It is said that she arrives without warning, making her presence known with an incredible record. Wait, this is obviously Kuroneko, right? How long have you been visiting these places, anyway...

TITLE: [FI] Two Shot Photo Sticker
DESCRIPTION: [FI] A fearsome item formed from the heat of the moment. If this was seen by others, it'll be extremely agonizing for me. For now, I think I'll stash it in a place where I can take it out and grin looking at it.

TITLE: [FI] Hinata's Advice
DESCRIPTION: [FI] A valuable suggestion I received from an elementary schooler. Worried about her older sister's love life in high school, and partially just for her own entertainment, she gave me some words of wisdom. To quote her, setting the mood is important.

TITLE: [FI] Denpa Song
DESCRIPTION: [FI] The song Kirino made me listen to, literally a quirky song. One that can make you question the sense of the person who made it. "Secret×2" was chosen secretly during an anime's "theme song campaign" as the Producer's Pick hit song.

TITLE: [FI] Obeying Instincts
DESCRIPTION: [FI] The whispers of the devil trying to shake off the restraint of reason. Any man has these urges, but plan accordingly. Why? Because if you choose to give in, you will never go back to how things were.

TITLE: [FI] Makishima Saori
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] Saori showed me her true self. Which is a shy, introverted, and a picture-perfect lady. She felt ashamed of this, saying it's the most pathetic part of her...

Well, it looks like she gets embarrassed as long as she's being watched by others. Still, the idea of wearing a blindfold every time we meet is going overboard, so I'm gonna have to get her over it quickly. But seriously, Saori, she... blindfolded me, feeling me up as I was defenseless, humiliating me after that...

TITLE: [FI] Saori Bajeena
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] The Saori we're all used to, Bajeena, who manages an otaku circle. In this aspect, she is a master at being an otaku. According to her though, her personality changes by wearing these glasses... A completely different person from her original lady self. What an amazing transformation.

I've always thought she had a lot of hobbies but, the extent of it was beyond my imagination. It's almost surreal to see a girl her age talking passionately about figurines at a showcase. Well, that side of her is really cute though.

TITLE: [FI] A Certain Fujiko
DESCRIPTION: [FI] The heroine of a certain anime known nationwide... Heroine? From what I saw, Saori's three sizes can rival "a certain Fujiko". Honestly, when I heard that comparison, I was stunned. She's that big at her age... how outrageous...

TITLE: [FI] A Certain Norika
DESCRIPTION: [FI] From wherever I heard it from, Saori's three sizes are apparently really similar to "a certain Norika". Honestly, when I heard that comparison, I was stunned. She's that big at her age... how outrageous...

TITLE: [FI] Black Tri-Stars
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] Three moles on the bottom of a certain person's breast. It was named the "Black Tri-Stars" due to the way the moles were gathered.

I discovered these marks on Saori's left breast when we visited the beach. As soon as I uttered this answer, it gave me a taste of what true murderous intent can do to a human being with just that.

TITLE: [FI] Otaku Girls Unite
DESCRIPTION: [FI] The otaku circle Saori is managing. That's how I got to know everyone. If it weren't for this circle, I would have never met Saori or Kuroneko, and my relationship with my sister wouldn't be the way it is today. With that train of thought, I am the way I am now, all thanks to Saori.

TITLE: [FI] The Big Dipper
DESCRIPTION: [FI] The seven scars left on a certain person's chest. A large asterism known as the "The Big Dipper", the arrangement of seven bright stars of the constellation Ursa Major.

TITLE: [FI] Pretty Garden
DESCRIPTION: [FI] The name of the maid cafe we frequent, and the name of the group once run by Saori's sister. The saying goes it's a small world, and it seems I often pass by that group's members without even knowing. Well, if you think about it, it's natural for otaku to flock to Akiba anyway, so the chances of running into them are higher than usual.

TITLE: [FI] Kurusu Kanata
DESCRIPTION: [FI] An older woman Saori calls master. So Saori's spiral glasses were a gift from her. Not only that, but I was really surprised when I found out she was older than me, despite how she looks.

TITLE: [FI] Laptop
DESCRIPTION: [FI] The AVIO laptop Kirino is currently using. Of course, she personally customized it to play Meruru's voice when the system boots.

TITLE: [FI] Makishima Kaori
DESCRIPTION: [FI] This handsome woman in a rider suit hiding her true identity is Saori's older sister. They're not exactly alike. Then again, Kirino and I don't look alike too. Guess the same can be said for sisters too.

TITLE: [FI] Manami's Spectacles
DESCRIPTION: [FI] An ordinary pair of glasses that Manami wears. Not much to say, really... There's nothing special about them; they truly are just normal glasses.

TITLE: [FI] Manami Without Spectacles
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Manami's glasses fit her so well, they are practically a part of her face. Come to think of it, I have barely seen her without them. Well, Manami's eyesight has been rather horrible so, she really can't live without them.

TITLE: [FI] Tamura Residence Pointcard
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] A point card I received from Gramps at the Tamura residence, who's always helping me out. Apparently, by doing things that make Manami happy, the points will automatically increase. What kind of high-tech is this...? Looks ordinary though. So basically, if I get enough points, something good happens...?

It seems Manami will manually press a seal on the card whenever she is happy. True, from my point of view, it's automatic... You know, she started off with so many the first time. At this rate, it will fill up immediately and... wait, let's not speculate. I won't be able to look at Manami in the eyes after.

I want to punch myself after getting so worked up over a point card. Manami was thinking about me, and yet... Our journey's coming to an end, but I'll properly attend to Manami with what little time there's left. I want to be able to puff my chest out with pride and claim I'm her boyfriend.

TITLE: [FI] Love Fortune-Telling Stone
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Two knee-high stones enshrined in the main area of the Jishu shrine. If a person can walk from one stone to the other with their eyes closed, their wish for love will come true. Frankly, it's completely pointless for someone already in a passionate relationship.

TITLE: [FI] Massage
DESCRIPTION: [FI] A therapy performed by direct contact with the skin. Effective for improving and promoting blood and lymphatic circulation. In addition, stimulation can relieve muscle pains, soothe the mood, and induce sleep. Now hold on, I have no ulterior motive here.

TITLE: [FI] Memories of the Trip
DESCRIPTION: [FI] I might forget the fun sightseeing and souvenirs, but leaving a memory in the form of photos has to be one of the best parts about a trip. It'll be even better when I can reminisce about this sometime in the future.

TITLE: [FI] I Love Manami
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Our emotions are truly mysterious things. Just when you think you're lost, it suddenly emerges and takes shape. Because of that, I was really distant from Manami... No, that's just an excuse. Anyway, I can now say with all my heart that I love Manami. And that's enough for me.

TITLE: [FI] Botanical Garden
DESCRIPTION: [FI] My recommended date plan that Ayase instantly rejected. There isn't going to be a second time... Then again, since I had no experience with this sorta thing, this is all I could come up with. Looks like I'll have to keep an eye out for research purposes.

TITLE: [FI] Akihabara
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Ayase is struggling to understand Kirino's hobby. Being concerned for your friends is fine and all but... that doesn't mean you should use that as a reason to go on a date with your boyfriend at Akiba. Just how much do you like Kirino...? I really wanna know who is ahead on Ayase's priority list, Kirino or me.

TITLE: [FI] Matchmaking
DESCRIPTION: [FI] A casual remark from Saori. But thinking carefully, there's a subtle meaning behind it. It sounds like that due to family circumstances, this matchmaking would be just one step away from an arranged marriage.

TITLE: [FI] Devoted Ayase
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] Since we became lovers, I feel that Ayase has become much less likely to disagree with my opinions. I guess that's how much she trusts me. I have to work hard to answer those feelings. But isn't it bad for you to hold back and put up with it? I hope she isn't doing that...

It's tiring to be in an unfamiliar place, even if you're with someone you love. And if you're surrounded by things you hate... that's gotta be tough. Even I would want some relief. So don't be in such a hurry and take your time, little by little... Well, that's about all I can say right now.

Up until this date, I realized just how much Ayase had been willing to go along with me. Judging from her smile today, she might've endured a lot. Well, I've had a lot of fun, ain't so bad being dragged around by my girlfriend.

TITLE: [FI] Saori's Mail
DESCRIPTION: [FI] A text from a reliable friend who can't read between the lines. It wasn't just the bad timing, but the content of the text is horrible. I'm almost at the point of grabbing her by the collar and saying "You could've waited until my date was over?" Then again, she did do a lot to help, so I can't complain...

TITLE: [FI] Kanako's Consultation
DESCRIPTION: [FI] A text from someone who can't read between the lines. Again. Are they purposely trying to contact me only when I'm on a date...? Well, they did go out of their way to reach me, maybe something important happened. At the very least, I'll ask about it later.

TITLE: [FI] Worldly Desires
DESCRIPTION: [FI] The sad nature that worries me on many occasions. It is something closest to all men of the world, and sometimes stands as their worst enemy. But, without this, one can't be called a true man.

TITLE: [FI] Erotic Things
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Apparently to Kanako, the act of kissing is also an erotic thing. She called me a pervert and degenerate and such. Are you really gonna be that harsh towards your boyfriend? Usually... Well, I got to see Kanako turning bright red in embarrassment so, let's just leave it at that.

TITLE: [FI] Kiss
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] The proof of love, according to Kanako. Well, if that soothes your worries, I'll do it as much as you want. I'm your boyfriend, after all. But spare me and avoid doing it in a place full of people. The glares of the people nearby feel like daggers, okay?!

Kanako kissing me first thing in the morning... even if we are lovers, there's a time and place for... wait, isn't it fine since we're lovers? So you're saying I can kiss her out of the blue? No, wait, it could make things awkward... hmmm... what am I going to do...

TITLE: [FI] Lolicon
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] A standard skill that all perverted gentlemen of the world have. Those who possess this skill perceive an innocent girl as a fully-fledged woman. No, you're wrong. I am not a lolicon, the girl I fell in love with just happened to be a loli. I didn't fall for her looks, but for what's within... Yeah, I fell for her personality! Isn't that obvious?

No, seriously. I'm not a lolicon, the girl I fell in love with just happened-- ah, I can't argue with that? Huh...

TITLE: [FI] Sexual Harassment Senpai
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] My nickname that Sena spread throughout school. I never did anything like that, I swear! Well, I might've said something worthy of that title, and an incident happened that led to a misunderstanding. I'll admit to those. HOWEVER! The rumors that are floating around school are just--(omitted as I'm just trying to prove my innocence)

Thanks to Sena's misleading nickname "Sexual Harassment Senpai", it has caught on even in the Games Research Club. I have to explain the situation and prove my innocence... Honestly though, I have zero confidence I can convince them otherwise. Damnit, if I get called Sexual Harassment Senpai even at club, I'll seriously cry!

Now that I've calmed down and reflected on my actions, why did I think I could massage her breasts at that time? Even I don't know. It's as if I got a command from the great beyond and I had to act... Yeah, I definitely deserve that nickname.

TITLE: [FI] The Problem Closet
DESCRIPTION: [FI] The closet that Sena used to observe her brother for the purpose of using him as homoerotic material. This incident is where Akagi learned that his sister is a pervert with a special interest. Honestly, I respect that aggressiveness. If my sister... No, just imagining it makes me want to die.

TITLE: [FI] I'm Rotten.
DESCRIPTION: [FI] A fact I should never forget when working with Sena. If I do end up forgetting, I'll be sucked to the bone as a material for her homoerotic fantasies. Well, even if you proceed with caution, there's no way to stop the delusions...

TITLE: [FI] It's Just Life Experience
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Regarding the matchmaking, Saori only said this. She said, "Please forget about this," but her expression seemed sad. There could be something more behind this.

TITLE: [FI] Working Overtime
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Sena, passionate about game creation, has been doing all this extra work alone. She did all this without telling her fellow club members. I can't help but admire her perseverance in doing this for many days on end, without mentioning a word of it. She really loves games, huh...

TITLE: [FI] Becoming good at something because you love it
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Kirino and the others are like this too but, the energy they put into what they like is unparalleled. It's overwhelming to watch. Like they don't know when to stop and yet, she seems to be having a lot of fun. Just watching this makes me want to do something too... Well, I'll do what I can.

TITLE: [FI] Surrounding Gaze
DESCRIPTION: [FI] As a fujoshi, Sena understands she's in the minority, so she's sensitive to the stares of those around her. Still, I've heard that she conducts herself well in class. For someone who's able to keep up an act to be so self-indulgent, it's safe to assume she lets her guard down around me... right?

TITLE: [FI] Fight
DESCRIPTION: [FI] With words as sharp as a blade, the opponent's mind is gouged out and the damage is done. That said, there's also the risk of a counter-attack...

TITLE: [FI] Defend
DESCRIPTION: [FI] The command to defend yourself from the opponent's dangerous words. Rare chance for a counter-attack. It's really rare.

TITLE: [FI] Special Move
DESCRIPTION: [FI] A truly formidable special move with the power to take out even the most powerful siscon in a single blow... Before these words, all things siscon are neutralized. Big brother Akagi defeated!

TITLE: [FI] Abe no Seimei
DESCRIPTION: [FI] A person related to the pentagram Kuroneko asked me to bring back as a souvenir. He was an exorcist who protected Kyoto by destroying the evil spirits of the mountains and rivers during the Heian era. However this time, Abe no Seimei's motif appears to be that of "Youkai-buster♪ Seimei-chan" from an anime airing late at night.

TITLE: [FI] Heian Animation
DESCRIPTION: [FI] According to Saori, an anime company that will be the one to lead the future of the anime world. Abbreviated as HeiAni. There seems to be some Original Goods you can only buy in HeiAni, but due to its success, you need to make an appointment in order to visit.

TITLE: [FI] Renowned Shop's Oil-Absorbing Sheets
DESCRIPTION: [FI] "Something I want to try using before work" is what Ayase said she wanted as a souvenir. "You're being evaded by the boys because of your oily skin!?" "Even the boys feel refreshed when they're not oily!" is what the recent campaign says. Recently, the product has gained popularity among women and men alike.

TITLE: [FI] Regional Edition Meruru
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Kirino instructed me to buy the entire set as a souvenir. The Kyoto version is themed after the numerous famous shrines and temples in Kyoto. It seems that there's also a Tokyo Meruru, an Akihabara Meruru, Ikebukuro Meruru, etc. etc. being released on the market.

TITLE: [FI] Tournament Prizes
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] The tournament's prizes that both Kirino and Kuroneko are dying for. To Kirino, who really loves sister-related games, this prize is the pinnacle of her collection! It might be a good idea to try and bait her with it. When Kirino goes berserk, showing this to her might calm her down. The second place prize is a Siscaly artbook with autographs from

the voice actors. By the way, the voice actor will say the winner's name in a special version of the game gifted to him or her. If that's the case, I felt that's kinda embarrassing to play.

TITLE: [FI] Popularity
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Akagi spoke of this when he saw me carrying tons of souvenirs. Since a really popular guy said this, it would seem really sarcastic. Of course, Manami isn't included since she's together with us for the school trip.

TITLE: [FI] Treated as a Stranger
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Even as a joke, being treated as a stranger is a sad thing. However, Kirino's memory loss is no joke. I've been entrusted by Dad to help Kirino recover her memory at all cost. Manami says that Kirino bears no ill will, she is merely feeling lonely and wants some attention... Or so it seems... I don't get why.

TITLE: [FI] The Older Brother!
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Something Dad told me. That old stub actually said "I'll leave Kirino to you." to make me realize my role as an older brother. No matter how it is, Kirino is my little sister.

TITLE: [FI] A Truly Important Person
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Rock seems to think highly of Manami; does Kirino also think of me like that...? Sure enough, Kuroneko and Saori are also important people to her, but... Their relationship is currently... strained. I'm the only one she can rely on at the moment.

TITLE: [FI] A Real Brother
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Up until now, I hadn't done anything Brother-like, but this year we made many unforgettable memories together. As a brother, I must remove my little sister's worries... It doesn't matter how poorly I've been treated as a brother, I'm still the only brother she has.

TITLE: [FI] Something's Strange
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Kuroneko realized Kirino isn't comfortable with online chats. Similarly, Saori also realized that Kirino might be hiding something? There's a reason for that - Kirino was acting strange in online chat a few days ago. Something must have happened while I was on the school trip.

TITLE: [FI] I always always loved you.
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] A confession you can hear Rinko say in her route in SisXSis. Kirino squirms with pleasure at this godly line. This scene where she summons the courage to confess to her brother could revive her lost memories. You may think that it's just a line in a game, that a similar conversation unrolling in front of her would do the trick, but... I wonder if she

wouldn't find reality odd compared to a game.

TITLE: [FI] My Friends
DESCRIPTION: [FI] The memory-less Kirino has nothing but contempt for Kuroneko and Saori from the otaku circle. Even though it's a temporary condition, I don't want to hear that from Kirino who values her friends a hundred times more than her brother. However, Kuroneko and Saori are Kirino's true friends. There should be a way to explain the reason behind this...

TITLE: [FI] The True Kirino
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Even if she has lost her memories, I won't recognize a Kirino that looks down on her friends. Not only for Kuroneko and Saori's sake, but also for Kirino's sake. There's a place where I want to show her for just a moment to bring back her memories... But for the current Kirino, this word is taboo.

TITLE: [FI] New Self
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Refusing to accept the fact that she was once an otaku, Kirino, wishing to obtain a 'new self,' has given up trying to get her memories back. Sure enough, the Otaku factor is unacceptable for the brilliant Kirino but... is this really okay, Kirino?

TITLE: [FI] National Class
DESCRIPTION: [FI] It refers to Kuroneko's gaming ability. Even Kirino, who doesn't like losing, at least recognizes Kuroneko's "great gaming skills". To win the prizes in the Siscaly tournament, Kuroneko's powers are of utmost importance. We have to believe in Kuroneko. This may sound odd, but mere humans are unlikely to beat Kuroneko.

TITLE: [FI] Cute Junior
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] Although she looks really reliable, Kuroneko really does mind that she is negligent of things she doesn't think of. It's a really cute characteristic that I, as a senior, want to protect. In the past, after being emphasized that "I'm not a replacement for your sister," I've conducted myself with dignity, but it seems like my meddlesome character won't be

denied that easily.

TITLE: [FI] Important Goal
DESCRIPTION: [FI] That's how Kirino thought of Kuroneko's odd behavior. It seems that in the eyes of Kirino, Kuroneko is harboring a goal that she would tell no one and is planning to complete it on her own. Kirino and Kuroneko, could it be that they think they're seeing opposites, but really, because of something close, they mutually understand each other?

TITLE: [FI] My World
DESCRIPTION: [FI] "Don't enter my world." Which means turning the sentence, "It'll trouble me, so don't interfere" into Kuroneko's style. Kuroneko's speech is very unique, so it's hard to guess what she's thinking. Like what she says, it's better not to interfere, but I still ignored her warning and interfered. This problem tests my decision-making ability.

TITLE: [FI] Classroom
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Kuroneko's classroom. Akagi's sister is also in the same class with Kuroneko. It was said that because of her eccentric speech, she was a loner at first. However, looks like she is able to find friends of similar interests, and blended into the class bit by bit.

TITLE: [FI] Club
DESCRIPTION: [FI] The club Kuroneko joined. Akagi's sister, like Kuroneko, also joined the same club. Because of certain things that happened in this club, I happened to be a member also, however I used examinations as a reason to not take part in the activities.

TITLE: [FI] Shoe Rack
DESCRIPTION: [FI] The school's shoe rack. It'll be crowded during the start and end of a school day. During Valentine's day, when students open their compartments, their hearts will beat furiously... But, I haven't received any presents or love letters since birth, nor have I seen anyone receive them before. I've recently been thinking that this is all an urban legend.

TITLE: [FI] Important Friend
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Although it's embarrassing to be called that, it's a sentence that doesn't make one unhappy. In other words, close friends. However, if an old friend that hasn't been seen for a long time were to say "I'm one of your important friends, right? Take it as helping me, could you please buy this lucky pot?" then this friendship is practically finished.

TITLE: [FI] Like a Little Sister
DESCRIPTION: [FI] I will not see any girl younger than me... as a little sister. Absolutely.

TITLE: [FI] Untamed Cat
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Kuroneko, whom has been avoiding those that she knows, is just like a cat avoiding humans. As with what Kirino had said, it's better to be forceful and stop Kuroneko before she takes it too far. However, I'm certain this isn't a example that will make people happy.

TITLE: [FI] My Own Future
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Before worrying about others, I should take care of my own future first. That was Kuroneko's warning to me. I do think she's right when she says that, however, even if I tried to do that, it can't be helped since my body involuntarily worries about her. So, I guess I'll do what I want to do and I'll act on my own belief.

TITLE: [FI] Keep Calm!
DESCRIPTION: [FI] In order to calm down Kirino, who has been provoked by Kuroneko, Saori said this. The prizes are the objective behind joining this tournament. Now isn't the time to be quarreling.

TITLE: [FI] "The things that should be done"
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Even if I don't have anything in particular I would like to do, passing every single day ordinarily... It seems like a fulfilling life to others. I just don't get it.

TITLE: [FI] Will Never Come True
DESCRIPTION: [FI] This is something that's very difficult to say. With such heavy words, I guess Saori had been forced to convince herself. Something that she had deeply pondered over before saying.

TITLE: [FI] Truly Valuable Things
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Her collections that are filled with memories. This is something Saori definitely does not want to lose... But as the saying goes, it's impossible to understand a woman's heart. Is it that only another woman will be able to understand what a woman is thinking?

TITLE: [FI] "I am already all right."
DESCRIPTION: [FI] What Saori said when I went to visit her while she was hospitalized. Is she really okay? Or is she just putting an act? That is something I can't tell.

TITLE: [FI] Promise About The Future
DESCRIPTION: [FI] The answer I got when I asked Kirino the "The meaning behind a guy keeping something important by a girl's request" It can't be helped since Kirino didn't know the circumstances, but I think it's still out of the point. But, making a "Promise About The Future" is a thing that must not be made with half-hearted feelings.

TITLE: [FI] Do whatever you want
DESCRIPTION: [FI] These are the words Kirino said irresponsibly. It seems she was angry with me because I didn't tell her Saori was hospitalized. It seems she was worried about Saori... Even so, those aren't the kind of words you want to hear.

TITLE: [FI] To Try the patience of a Saint
DESCRIPTION: [FI] No matter how large one's patience is, there is a limit. I can't continue being evaded by Saori this way. If I have to use a more proactive way of approaching, in this case it's valid.

TITLE: [FI] Bracelet
DESCRIPTION: [FI] According to Kuroneko, this is an amulet that has the protection of the Fallen Angel. It seems she made it so it could be a type of amulet, but with that bizarre design, it's not that easy to be happy about it.

TITLE: [FI] If the compatibility is bad, it's impossible
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Even if the looks, intelligence, and personality isn't bad, if there is no fundamental compatibility in between, it is impossible for the relationship to last long. It doesn't matter if your parents are willing, to let the Marriage Interview's partner get into an engagement is not good, after all.

TITLE: [FI] The Misery of a Child
DESCRIPTION: [FI] It's the idea that a child's rearing determines whether or not the child will be happy in life. Like my father says, "Parents who think about things other than their children are useless." But does this also apply to Saori's parents?

TITLE: [FI] School Trip
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] One of the activities to mark the end of senior high school, it's an outdoors learning experience at Kyoto for three days and two nights. You can understand why I completely forgot about it, right? The main thing about school trips is to enjoy the local culture and history, as well as gossiping about things like love interests with your

friends after lights out.

TITLE: [FI] Love Otaku hobbies
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Even if she likes Otaku hobbies that much, Saori is trying to get away from them because of her fiancé. However, that's not something good for Saori or for her fiancé. Saori is a great person who always takes into account her surroundings but, what's necessary for Saori is to "Learn to love herself more."

TITLE: [FI] My Girlfriend
DESCRIPTION: [FI] If you were born a man, that is the only thing you want to have at least once, no matter what- that's a girlfriend. This time, because of a reason, Manami became mine, but I still can't get the feeling that she is my girlfriend.

TITLE: [FI] Engagement
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Self-explanatory, the promise of marriage. To be serious, I can't picture a wedding scene with Manami in my head at all but, I also can't picture Manami alongside any other person. But, to set something as important as a promise to be united in the future this easily, is it fine?

TITLE: [FI] Galge
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] It refers to a game where a lot of cute girls appear. The protagonist is a man who has nearly no special qualities or abilities, yet is surrounded by lots of cute girls that are in love with him. Something that would never happen in reality, that kind of genre. For example, when the morning comes, your childhood friend always comes to wake you

up, when it's lunch time a heroine will make you lunch, you go back home from school with a heroine everyday, the protagonist continues to live this oh-so-enviable life for all the other men. Seriously, if there is someone that's living this kind of life, I really want to meet him.

TITLE: [FI] Memories of Youth
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] The comment Akagi made when he saw the lunch made by Manami. Actually, it is true that the lunch made by your childhood friend is one of the pages of your youth. There are others, like running in a beach towards the sunset with each other or riding a bike together on the riverbank, those are indispensable memories just like the Koshien of

Summer.

TITLE: [FI] The Old Manami
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] Kuroneko said, "When ensnared by the phantasms of the past, happiness is impossible." The Old Manami- the Manami before she became my girlfriend- was always a person capable of making me comfortable. But that's not how it is currently. Now, whenever I'm with Manami, I get the feeling only painful things will occur. Is

remembering the Old Manami really that bad of a thing?

TITLE: [FI] The Eyes of a Girl in Love
DESCRIPTION: [FI] "Missing Translation Here" Then that means instead of "liking" me, Manami is "in love" with me. Is it okay to call this kind of relationship that of lovers?

TITLE: [FI] I love you the most
DESCRIPTION: [FI] Although Ayase said I was 'frivolous,' those are my heartfelt words. The innocent reaction from Ayase-chan made my initial passion for her soar. Please don't be mistaken, 'initial passion' refers to a kind of mental energy. I'm thinking of saying it again at a 'crucial point' to express my resolution.

TITLE: [FI] H-Game
DESCRIPTION: [FI] 'SisXSis' and 'SISCALY' are examples of little sister-type games that Kirino likes. Although I've got Ayase to accept 'The bond of love between Kirino and me' setup... It has been exposed long ago...

TITLE: [FI] Leave it to me
DESCRIPTION: [FI] It's a decisive line I've come up with. Got a problem? This line will certainly have its effect when preparing myself mentally.

TITLE: [FI] The Marriage Waterfall of Kiyomizu-dera
DESCRIPTION: [FI] One of the places Manami wants to visit during the school trip. There's a rumor (unconfirmed) that drinking the water from the Otowa Waterfall will allow you to meet a good marriage partner. Visiting that temple with the waterfall is nice and all, but the water drinking is a trap for those who gave up... Sorry, Manami.

TITLE: [FI] Summer Comiket
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] "The Summer's Comic Circle Market," which everyone has dubbed Summer Comiket (Natsucomi). It seems that winter has a "Winter Comiket (Fuyucomi)," but I didn't go for that. "Natsucomi" is hot and wet, "Fuyucomi" is said to be hot and cold? Anyway, Saori could still remember that she met Ayase once... On a side note, Kirino and

Ayase quarreled because both of them have met coincidentally during last year's "Natsucomi"... It might be better for me to bring Ayase here to understand Kirino's hobby...

TITLE: [FI] Explore the Inn
DESCRIPTION:
[FI] It seems it was the dream of Akagi during the School Trip to spy on the girls while they're bathing or in their rooms. ※This ORE can be used after you have started a "New Game." Inside the Inn, there was an 8-Bit Style Game. Inside, there was probably a room with the hobby of the host. You can continue from there to the "Legendary

Alternate Fushimi Inari", this again is an 8-bit Style Dungeon Game. As a result, it was a lot of unnecessary content...

TITLE: [FI] Other Side
DESCRIPTION: [FI] "...Kyousuke, I love you" （ﾟДﾟ）Huh? What are you saying now... Kirino can't possibly say something like that. The Kirino I know wouldn't take "that" kind of attitude towards me!! Being that as it may, I recommend you to play again.... ※This ORE can be used after you have started a "New Game."

TITLE: [FI] The Album of Memories
DESCRIPTION: [FI] ...I can't muster up any good words. Why do I have this album? This album only existed in that "Dark Space"... in Kirino's bedroom, this thing is from that space, without a doubt. ※This ORE can be used after you have started a "New Game."

TITLE: [FI] My Little Sister Can't Be This Cute
DESCRIPTION: [FI] 'My little sister' refers to my only little sister, 'Kirino'... 'Cute' is...well, how should I put it... Such thoughts emerged from my heart, and there have been a couple of times ever since... ※This ORE can be used after you have started a "New Game."

TITLE: [FI] Kitano Tenman-gū
DESCRIPTION: [FI] One of the places Manami wants to visit during the school trip. A shrine dedicated to Sugawara Michizane, the god of knowledge. Every year, many students and test takers visit this shrine.

TITLE: [FI] Increase Our Chances of Victory
DESCRIPTION: [FI] For the sake of the best prize, in Kirino's mind, everything counts toward raising our chances of victory. However, she also wants to participate together with her friends. Later on, in response to those feelings, Kuroneko announced, "The word "defeat" does not exist for battles I partake in."

TITLE: [FI] Radio Kaikan
DESCRIPTION: [FI] A shopping center that is located at the entrance of the electronic district of Akihabara. It is a holy land that has everything from music equipment and home electronics to computer parts, figurines, doujinshi, games, etc.
